title: Count repeated items
summary: A locator can match several elements. toHaveCount checks how many matches exist.
introduction: A locator can match several elements. toHaveCount checks how many matches exist. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A locator can match several elements. toHaveCount checks how many matches exist.

blocks.title: Count repeated items

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add Zoo and update the expected count.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A count alone does not check the text of every item.
For more detail later, use this [Playwright further reading](https://playwright.dev/docs/intro).
